'''2018 Worlds Day 2 Jared Napolitano LS This Is Getting Out Of Hand''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jared Napolitano]] at [[2018 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jared Napolitano]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open This Is Getting Out Of Hand Napolit.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127123938/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ Internet Archive]
